notes: Canonical weapon clicks from dnd5e Actor inventory rows now open the FEHA weapon interface instead of immediately invoking the stock dnd5e attack/use flow.
The bridge resolves the clicked owned Item from the containing Actor application and only intercepts canonical FEHA weapons, leaving explicit inventory management controls alone.
Problem-patch weapons such as Black Requiem, Achilles, Razor Choir, Monarch Zero, and the other canonical catalog guns therefore route into the same FEHA weapon page from the Actor sheet.
Weapon windows no longer force a tall fixed height. They widen when needed, then auto-fit their height to the rendered FEHA content and clamp to the viewport.
The FEHA page root no longer uses 100% height, removing the large empty black area beneath shorter weapon pages.
No weapon damage, DEX rules, shot tracking, reload cadence, Market stock, armor, cyberware, grenade, or Quickhack rules changed.
